desc: Find your favorite game and call your friends, no matter how far you are, you can enjoy the game immediately on the SadSha GameBox, save the progress, continue next time.
feature1Desc: SadSha GameBox collected a large number of games. After starting your favorite game, SadSha GameBox will create a room, you can invite friends to play together.
feature1Title: Massive games for you to choose
feature2Desc: SadSha GameBox reliable technology allows you and your friends to conduct low-latency videos and audio transmission, just like playing in the same room.
feature3Desc: SadSha GameBox can synchronize your keys, rendering settings, and sound settings. When you switch the device, you can quickly play the game.
